# Northstar Brokerage Dashboard

- This project uses React, JavaScript, Vite, and CSS. The application entry is `src/App.jsx`; shared styles are in `src/index.css`.
- Use the existing Lucide icons and Recharts components for interface controls and data visualization.
- Run `npm run lint` and `npm run build` from the `broker-app` directory after code changes.
- Portfolio figures, quotes, trade previews, and support chat are demo-only and local to the browser. Do not imply they connect to a broker, market-data provider, or live support agent.
- Keep the dashboard and all controls usable at mobile widths and maintain visible keyboard focus styles.
